processing: Entire approved 1295 x 1214 canvas fitted to the established 300 x 400 game face with Pillow Lanczos and WebP quality 80, method 6. No selective crop, repainting or colour edits. The committed SVG is a game export, not the full-resolution original.
approval: Carl approved GitHub deployment of the latest red 六萬 calligraphy with lemons, cypresses, lake and village as 6 characters (6m). The earlier sunflower study is not selected and no other tile is changed.
originalPreservation: Untouched full-resolution PNG preserved in Van_Gogh_6_Characters_Lemon_Terrace_Approved.zip supplied in chat.
